findings.issue: שֶׁסַע is masculine and the fronted object; the 3fs suffix and feminine qal participle agree with the animal, which does the cleaving. Spanish makes hendidura the subject of no es hendiente.
גֵּרָה is a common noun and must be Spanish; cud is an untranslated English word.

The 3fs negative and hiphil participle leave the animal as the one causing ascent (גֵּרָה feminine, so subject is open); Spanish locks cud as the subject of intransitive subiente, a qal-like going up.
Qal imperfect 3ms is plain becoming-unclean; se is Spanish inchoative smoothing and does not add another actor.

notes: ella partiente pezuña, impuros ellos a ustedes, and todo el tocante en ellos match the remaining tokens, including ustedes for 2mp.
